seeded_failure.symptom: Grafana dashboards show empty graphs for application metrics, even while k6 load generator reports successful HTTP responses.
seeded_failure.cause: Prometheus scrape configuration targets port 8080 instead of the application metric exporter port 9090.
seeded_failure.fix: Update prometheus.yml to scrape port 9090, restart the Prometheus container, and verify targets status at http://localhost:9090/targets.

lab_rubric: Stack Deployment
All containers run healthy, stack starts with zero errors, and endpoints pass health checks automatically.
Stack deploys successfully and all core monitoring services are running and accessible.
Stack starts partially, but one or more telemetry services fail to stay up.
Stack fails to deploy or major containers exit immediately.
Telemetry Collection
Metrics, structured logs, and distributed trace exemplars flow into Grafana seamlessly during k6 load tests.
Metrics, logs, and traces are visible in Grafana panels during the load test.
Metrics arrive in Grafana, but logs or traces are missing or unlinked.
No telemetry data appears in Grafana during or after load generation.
Version Control & Structure
Clean Git repo layout with modular config files, well-formatted commit history, and zero hardcoded credentials.
Configurations, alerts, and dashboards are committed to the reliability repository.
Files are committed, but directory structure is messy or configs contain inline secret values.
Configurations are not saved to Git or repo is incomplete.
Troubleshooting the seeded failure
Identifies incorrect scrape port immediately via target logs or status page and resolves issue cleanly.
Resolves port mismatch with minimal hint from trainer.
Pinpoints that Prometheus cannot scrape data but fails to identify the exact config mismatch.
Unable to diagnose or fix the telemetry blackout issue.

seeded_failure.symptom: The service monitoring dashboard displays 100% uptime even when the backend database container is completely stopped.
seeded_failure.cause: The application health probe script is hardcoded to return HTTP status 200 without validating backend database connectivity.
seeded_failure.fix: Modify the application configuration to enable deep health checks, restart the web container, and verify that stopping the database reports downtime.
